why: C7: the btn_checkout block schema (main-cart.liquid L469-…) has no full_width setting (L243 reads block.settings.full_width but no such setting exists, and lint checks template settings against the schema), so the cart page's checkout button needs a skin rule. New rule — insert after line 105 (the drawer checkout hover rule), i.e. at line 106, still inside §6. Same fill, btn-ink, 52 px, no letter-spacing as line 104's drawer rule, plus width:100% for the full column; the button markup <button form="{{ form_id }}" type="submit" name="checkout"> is unchanged. The #hdt-page-cart prefix mirrors line 104's #CartDrawer shape so it beats Kalles' .hdt-btn/.hdt-btn--size-m rules regardless of load order (hdt-main-cart.css is loaded from the section body, after the skin).
C7 companion: the hover/focus state, identical to line 105's drawer rule so the two checkout buttons behave the same. Insert directly after the rule above (line 107).

D4: drop display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical so the full name wraps (trunc=false); everything else on the line kept verbatim. Kalles' own .hdt-mini-cart__title{width:100%} stays.
D5: split of line 98 into two lines. The variant rule MUST come second: the variant div also carries .hdt-text-secondary and both selectors are (1,1,0), so source order decides the gold.
D6: insert as a new line directly after current line 99 (the price/gold rule) — the 12 px «N ₪ ליחידה» mute line under the line total.

D3 void: insert as two new lines after current line 103 (the .hdt-mini-cart__bottom rule). hdt-cart-drawer.css has .hdt-mini-cart__main{flex:1 1 auto} inside cart-items-component.hdt-mini-cart__wrap{flex:1 1 auto;height:100%} — that is the stretch. But the scroll div .hdt-mini-cart__sroll carries Kalles' .hdt-full-width-link{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;left:0;z-index:2} (base css) and .hdt-mini-cart [data-hdt-scroll-me]{overflow:auto}, so with flex:0 alone main would collapse to 0 px (its only child is absolute). position:static gives main its content height; flex:0 1 auto + min-block-size:0 lets it shrink when lines exceed the space; max-block-size:100% keeps [data-hdt-scroll-me] as the scroller, and overflow:auto on main is the fallback if the percentage does not resolve (dialog is max-height:100dvh, not height). No theme JS references data-hdt-scroll-me or .hdt-mini-cart__sroll (grepped the mirror JS).

D2: replaces line 106. The <a> no longer has .hdt-btn, so the selector drops it. Centred text link (block flex, max-content width, auto inline margins), 44 px tap box via 13 px padding (+min-height guard), ink-2, no pill, no border. letter-spacing:0/text-transform:none are still needed: hdt-cart-drawer.css keeps .hdt-mini-cart__btn-viewcart,.hdt-mini-cart__btn-checkout{font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:.3rem;text-transform:uppercase} on the bare class. The hairline underline is drawn with text-decoration (hair-btn colour, 4 px offset) instead of .env2-link's border-bottom so it stays under the text inside the padded 44 px box; border:0 also zeroes that border-bottom. Kalles' .hdt-mini-cart__btn-viewcart{margin-top:2rem} is left in place (margin-inline only).
D2: replaces line 107 — glow on hover/focus for the text link; no border-color any more.
D8: new line after the (new) 107. One link per line, centred. Beats Kalles' .hdt-mini-cart__emty>*+*{margin-top:2.4rem} (0,1,0) with the 18 px the spec asks for.

RECOMMENDED, not in the D-list: the visual half of D7. Kalles has no rule for a disabled stepper button and skin line 101 forces color:var(--env2-ink) on it, so the disabled minus at qty 1 would look identical to the live one. Kalles' validateQtyRules only toggles a .disabled class (no rule for it either); the disabled attribute stops the click handler. Lead's call.

RECOMMENDED, not in the D-list: the snippet's own p.ens-terms-line{margin:10px 0 0} (written for the PDP, under a button) adds 10 px on top of .hdt-mini-cart__bottom-wrap's 2rem padding, i.e. 10 px of the measured void. Lead's call.
